page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, centred, with the page number at top right. Below the text: signature "Bb 4" at left and catchword "diaris" at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: strantia : sed hæc sunt Postulatis tuis satis superqve, jamqve Epistolæ modum longe supergressi sumus ; velim autem, eruditissime Buxtorfi, accipias à me ista, non ut decretorie dicta. Feram facile, qvi aliter senserit, licet caducis admodum rationibus niti mihi videatur.

Natura non possumus non amare opus qvod excolui-mus, & amanti τὰ μὴ καλὰ, καλὰ πειράντα, hæc περιλήψις[?] exuat animum suum necesse est eum, qvi oppositæ sici sententiæ refutationem aggreditur, alioqvin id, qvod adversarius asserit, capere vix potest, nedum refutare. Licet ea, qvæ retuli, videantur mihi admodum perspicua, omnemqve solutionis ansam præripere, amico tamen animo ea refutantem, non modo facile feram, sed etiam de me bene mereri existimabo.
Falli possum & nonnunqvam expertus sum, ea qvæ judicabam admodum perspicua, aliter se habuisse.
Allatas rationes si in libro, cujus editionem paras, dissolveris, & mihi & aliis multis magnum operæ pretium feceris : Hoc vero si irrito canatu aggre-

page.notes: The first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page; its first letter is a damaged ligature, read here as "s". The Greek "πειράντα" and the word "περιλήψις" are uncertain from the scan, marked [?]. "canatu" is printed as it appears; it is probably a printing error for "conatu". The word "aggre-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page as "diaris".
